title: Token Kiln: Compact token-cost viewport + export wizard
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Design a compact, role-aware token-cost viewport (the 'Kiln') that surfaces per-invocation cost breakdowns, attribution heuristics and an export wizard optimized for large-scale CSV/NDJSON dumps. This ticket covers the end-to-end UX: compact list+detail viewport, lightweight sparklines, interactive attribution toggles, hierarchical cost rollups (route -> session -> invocation), and an export flow that supports segmented exports, anonymization presets, and cost-allocation columns for downstream billing systems.

Design constraints and tradeoffs: keep the Kiln readable at 9–12 rows per viewport for enterprise consoles with many routes; avoid heavy server-side joins in the first iteration (export will rely on precomputed cost slices from ENG-19821); prioritize incremental loading over full-table pagination to preserve console responsiveness for customers with millions of invocations. Evaluate CSV vs NDJSON formats for nested attribution data (decision leaning toward NDJSON for attribution detail and CSV for quick handoffs).

Success criteria: stakeholders can filter to a route and export a 30-day token-level ledger within defined cost and privacy presets; PM and Billing can reconcile exported cost rows back to usage ledgers; design passes accessibility and keyboard-nav review; engineering has clear column schema and rollup rules to implement.

Notes: this design intentionally favors a compact-pane first approach (vs. full-screen modal) because customers frequently want to cross-reference the Kiln with the per-model latency and cost traces panel. The export wizard includes named presets (Full Audit, Rollup Only, Data Safe) and a lightweight preview showing 3 sample rows before export.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Kiln viewport designs (list + detail flyout) delivered in Figma with component tokens and spacing rules; 2) Export wizard flows documented with column schema for CSV and NDJSON, anonymization presets and delta-download support; 3) Prototype clickable (Figma prototype or front-end sandbox) demonstrating filter -> attribution toggle -> export preview; 4) PM sign-off and ENG-19821 + ENG-20345 acknowledged as implementation dependencies; 5) Accessibility checklist completed (color contrast, keyboard nav, screenreader labels).

Called out three export modes: Full Audit (NDJSON), Rollup CSV (aggregated by session), and Data Safe (hashed IDs + redacted prompt excerpts).

Implemented the attribution slider (absolute vs proportional split) and a small sparkline column that shows cost density across the session. Uploaded link to artifacts. Requested engineering feasibility check for on-demand attribution expansion (ENG-19821).

2025-03-02 — Luis Herrera (Eng): Reviewed prototype. Feasibility notes: precomputed attribution slices must be emitted by the runtime pipeline to support fast preview. ENG asks to limit per-export sample preview to 500 rows client-side to avoid memory spikes. ENG-20345 created for backend export paginated streaming API.
